entries.descriptionOriginal:
🪜 Welcome to Depth Incremental! 🪜

Every step takes you deeper into the pit, and every layer hides something new and dangerous.

How deep can you go? 🕳️

How to play:
🪜 Buy steps and descend into the pit!
💰 Discover unique ways to upgrade your character!
🦴 Dig up Fossils and hunt rare Shinies ✨!
🌳 Expand many different Upgrade Trees!
👑 Defeat the bosses guarding each layer!
🔥 Rebirth, grow stronger, dive deeper

💎 Roblox Plus: +20% Luck

👍 Like & Favourite for more updates!

@CoreLoopDev - Everything
